subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at our company. We have carefully reviewed your qualifications and are impressed with your experience in digital marketing. We would like to invite you for an interview next week to further discuss your skills and how they align with our team. Please let us know your availability for the interview. We look forward to meeting you in person. Best regards, Hiring Manager
